must_pass: Rock, stone, timber and roof remain distinguishable at official camera.
Aserradero is not washed out and retains readable warm/cool material separation.
Cuartel is not over-bright or near-white and retains authored material identity.
Fog creates depth without flattening foreground and midground values.
Shadows reveal form without crushing entrances, stairs or gameplay-relevant silhouettes.
The same profile works on both Aserradero and Cuartel without per-building lighting hacks.
No false focal point is created mainly by exposure/brightness.
reject_if: city collapses into one grey value family
profile only looks good on one isolated asset
profile depends on asset-specific light overrides
note: candidate_order is diagnostic review order, not a winner ranking. Final selection requires image evidence.
